findings.issue: maxSurge 100% on the 20-node npworkload pool requires about 600 pod IPs (20 surge nodes x 30 maxPods) in snet-orders-workload while the upgrade drains, but the /25 subnet has roughly 60 free addresses — surge node and pod IP allocation will fail and the upgrade will stall mid-rollout, leaving the pool partially upgraded.
findings.fix: Drop maxSurge to a value the subnet can host (e.g. '10%', about 2 surge nodes x 31 addresses) or extend snet-orders-workload's address space (or move the pool to a larger subnet) before the window. The Kubernetes version bump and the cost-center tag change are benign and can merge as-is.
